notes: Resolve us_code from cn.country_code dict; resolve it1_id ('budget'), it2_id ('bottom 10 rank') from info_type.info varlen; resolve CT ids from company_type.kind varlen.
For each mid (title row index = mid-1): check py != INT32_MIN && py > 2000; check title bytes via len-prune + memcmp for 'Birdemic' prefix OR memmem for 'Movie' substring.

Only after title filter passes, probe mi offsets to find any row with info_type_id==it1_id capturing mi.info; and probe mc offsets to find any row with company_type_id in CT and cn.country_code[company_id-1]==us_code.

Both probes must produce at least one qualifying row (inner join). For MIN(mi.info), capture every qualifying mi.info to fold into running MIN; MIN(t.title) folds when both side existence checks succeed.
Lexicographic MIN over byte strings (length-then-bytes or full memcmp per implementation).
